import itertools, math
from mpmath import mp, mpf, cos, sqrt, pi
mp.dps = 60

def check(k):
    l = k // 2
    cs, cbs = [], []
    for j in range(1, l + 1):
        c = cos(j * pi / (k + 1))
        r = sqrt(1 + c * c)
        cs.append(c + r)
        cbs.append(c - r)
    vals = []
    for mask in range(1 << l):
        a = mpf(1)
        for j in range(l):
            a *= cs[j] if (mask >> j) & 1 else cbs[j]
        vals.append(a)
    # roots: even k -> x = 1/a_S ; odd k -> x = ±1/a_S, repeated iff |a_S| coincide
    key = [abs(v) if k % 2 == 1 else v for v in vals]
    key.sort()
    for i in range(len(key) - 1):
        if abs(key[i] - key[i + 1]) < mpf(10) ** -40 * max(1, abs(key[i])):
            return True
    return False

for k in range(1, 60):
    if check(k):
        print("repeated roots at k =", k)
        break
    else:
        print("simple at k =", k, flush=True)
